prior_summary: A deterministic causal phase rule chooses red, supplied-buffer, or blue as the chunk-frozen Cartesian position anchor; a learned two-frame encoder shared with a four-class phase head conditions 7D diffusion with TCP-relative orientation.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the phase-relevant red, buffer, or overlap-blue position is displaced but the observed state still clearly matches a demonstrated acquisition, transport/release, or overlap phase and remains reachable. Prefer buffer_red__h02 when phase or contact status is ambiguous.
termination_guidance: Require observed red stability at the supplied buffer and open/clear fingers for core handoff. A later switch after closed fingers around blue and visible blue lift is action-supervised. Anchor mode and auxiliary phase are not grasp or release proof.
limitations: Only selected-anchor TCP position is equivariant to displacement. Deterministic thresholds can choose the wrong anchor after misses, drops or unusual entries; orientation, posture, reachability, collisions and contact are not invariant. No recovery or out-of-distribution success is established.
